data.one_liner: Pure Dart implementation of the Signal Protocol for end‑to‑end encrypted messaging.
data.what_it_does: Provides Signal Protocol primitives such as identity key generation, pre‑key bundles, session building, and group messaging. Includes in‑memory stores and helpers to encrypt/decrypt messages across platforms.
use_when: You need end‑to‑end encryption in a pure‑Dart/Flutter app without native dependencies
Cross‑platform support (mobile, web, desktop) is required
You want to implement custom key stores or session management
avoid_when: A GPL‑3.0 license is unacceptable for your project
You need a highly‑optimized native cryptography library
You already use a different secure messaging protocol
strengths: Pure Dart, works on all Flutter platforms
No native code or platform channels required
Supports both one‑to‑one and group sessions
weaknesses: GPL‑3.0 license may limit commercial use
